# readout-docx

1. Do the analysis yourself with the toolchain Python (pandas is available). Never copy numbers from notes when the data can be computed.
2. Write `work/readout-spec.json`:

```json
{
  "title": "Q4 onboarding readout",
  "subtitle": "One line: scope and data source",
  "summary": "Two or three sentences with the answer first.",
  "sections": [{"heading": "...", "paragraphs": ["..."], "bullets": ["..."]}],
  "table": {"columns": ["Driver", "Churned", "Share"], "rows": [["...", "24", "31%"]]},
  "chart": {"title": "...", "labels": ["..."], "values": [24, 21], "value_label": "Churned respondents"},
  "sources_note": "Data: inputs/<file>; notes: memory ids"
}
```

Every key except `title` and `summary` is optional. Keep it to one page: at most 3 sections, 6 table rows, 6 chart bars.

3. Render: `"/Users/sam/Library/Application Support/com.fndr.app/hand-off/toolchain/venv/bin/python" .agents/skills/readout-docx/render.py work/readout-spec.json out/<name>.docx`
   It also writes `out/<name>-chart.png` when a chart is given.

inputs/q4-onboarding-survey.csv

import pandas as pd
p='inputs/q4-onboarding-survey.csv'
df=pd.read_csv(p)
y=df[df.churned.eq('yes')].copy()
print('duplicates IDs',df.respondent_id.duplicated().sum())
print('yes blank reason',y.churn_reason.isna().sum(),'no with reason',df[df.churned.eq('no')].churn_reason.notna().sum())
print('\\nReasons')
r=y.churn_reason.value_counts().rename('n').to_frame()
r['share_churned']=r.n/len(y)
r['share_all']=r.n/len(df)
print(r.to_string(formatters={'share_churned':'{:.1%}'.format,'share_all':'{:.1%}'.format}))
print('\\nChurn by segment')
s=df.groupby('segment').agg(respondents=('respondent_id','size'),churned=('churned',lambda x:(x=='yes').sum()))
s['rate']=s.churned/s.respondents
print(s.to_string(formatters={'rate':'{:.1%}'.format}))
print('\\nTop reason x segment')
print(pd.crosstab(y.churn_reason,y.segment).to_string())
print('\\nOnboarding step churn rates')
o=df.groupby('last_onboarding_step').agg(n=('respondent_id','size'),churn=('churned',lambda x:(x=='yes').sum()))
o['rate']=o.churn/o.n
print(o.sort_values('rate',ascending=False).to_string(formatters={'rate':'{:.1%}'.format}))
print('\\nMetrics churn')
print(df.groupby('churned').agg(n=('respondent_id','size'),avg_nps=('nps','mean'),median_nps=('nps','median'),avg_days=('days_to_first_report','mean'),median_days=('days_to_first_report','median')).to_string())
print('\\nTop reason metrics')
print(y.groupby('churn_reason').agg(n=('respondent_id','size'),avg_nps=('nps','mean'),avg_days=('days_to_first_report','mean')).sort_values('n',ascending=False).to_string())
PY"

"""Render a one-page readout .docx (and chart .png) from a JSON spec."""
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path

from docx import Document
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.shared import Inches, Pt, RGBColor

spec = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
out = Path(sys.argv[2])
if out.suffix != ".docx" or out.parent.name != "out":
    sys.exit("The output must be a .docx inside out/")

doc = Document()
section = doc.sections[0]
section.left_margin = section.right_margin = Inches(0.8)
section.top_margin = section.bottom_margin = Inches(0.7)
style = doc.styles["Normal"]
style.font.name = "Helvetica"
style.font.size = Pt(10.5)

title = doc.add_heading(spec["title"], level=0)
title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT
if spec.get("subtitle"):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(spec["subtitle"])
    p.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x55, 0x55, 0x55)
summary = doc.add_paragraph()
summary.add_run(spec["summary"]).bold = True

for sec in spec.get("sections", [])[:3]:
    doc.add_heading(sec["heading"], level=2)
    for para in sec.get("paragraphs", []):
        doc.add_paragraph(para)
    for bullet in sec.get("bullets", []):
        doc.add_paragraph(bullet, style="List Bullet")

table = spec.get("table")
if table:
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(table["columns"]))
    t.style = "Light Grid Accent 1"
    for cell, name in zip(t.rows[0].cells, table["columns"]):
        cell.text = str(name)
    for row in table["rows"][:6]:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for cell, value in zip(cells, row):
            cell.text = str(value)

chart = spec.get("chart")
if chart:
    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use("Agg")
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    labels, values = chart["labels"][:6], chart["values"][:6]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.2, 2.4), dpi=200)
    bars = ax.barh(labels[::-1], values[::-1], color="#3b6ea5")
    ax.bar_label(bars, padding=3, fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlabel(chart.get("value_label", ""), fontsize=8)
    ax.set_title(chart.get("title", ""), fontsize=9, loc="left")
    ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
    fig.tight_layout()
    png = out.with_name(out.stem + "-chart.png")
    fig.savefig(png)
    doc.add_picture(str(png), width=Inches(6.2))

if spec.get("sources_note"):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(spec["sources_note"])
    p.runs[0].font.size = Pt(8)
    p.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x77, 0x77, 0x77)

doc.save(out)
print(out)
